speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked the Minister for Law (a) whether all efforts have been taken to return the over $200 million in unclaimed CPF monies with no nomination to family members; and (b) whether the paperwork can be made easier for family members to apply to claim the monies.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
text: Individuals may come forward at any time to make their claim.

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Regarding those who have been contacted through phone or through house visits in a very personalised way, we can see that there are some interactions between the officers and the possible claimants.

speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: What are the reasons why they did not eventually make the claim?

speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
text: I can check the information, but if you reach out to someone who is legally entitled to and is able to substantiate that position, in most cases, those persons will step forward to make the claim.

speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
text: The numbers that we see, the unclaimed or the unnominated sums, relate to persons we were not able to trace in the manner which you heard the Minister for Manpower stated earlier.
